question: Fatima has only one sibling. She also has only one daughter Rushna. Rushna and Rameez are married to each other. Their maternal aunts are Maryam and Khadija, respectively. How is Khadija's mother related to Maryam's niece?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abf25944776d2a3ecedfc8ce453d6240c47cfde66b9c3a1ec4348e9237131af8.png] 

From the given information:

Step 1: Fatima has only one sibling. She also has only one daughter Rushna. Rushna and Rameez are married to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa31cb3619cc865e6b80408296988af3a7856a7eb305ce1813c04a575da9cfd1.png] 

Step 2: Their maternal aunts are Maryam and Khadija, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b117c8a23cd6188f3d914871b23ed691a8d702655ca2e520ab11df89444eaf.png] 

Now Khajida's mother will be Rameez's mother's mother and Rushna is married to Rameez.

So, **Khajida's mother is husband's mother's mother to Rushna **(who is Maryam's niece)**.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
